statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 that meets PCI DSS for both merchants and HIPAA for IT Support
Group CISO accountable; division leads named; IT Support HIPAA officials designated; executive PCI responsibility assigned
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level; device content and card data risks rated High must be treated
Supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation; in-store counter annex
Divisions document common control inheritance for every system and site
Sanctions, including for misuse of customer devices
No terms, no data, no code: vendor security terms and review before data access or software on benches and endpoints
Annual common control assessment and division samples
Security documentation retained 6 years
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Unique identities; no shared bench or portal logins
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 8.2.1); N54-R06 (45 CFR 164.312(a)(2)(i)); Manufacturer A agreement (contract)

statement_summary: Least privilege; STPP scoped by store and region; vault reads by assigned technician only
MFA for all; phishing-resistant for administrators and RMM administrators
Service and interface accounts owned, governed, and rotated
Access disabled within 4 hours of termination
Quarterly access certification including portal and RMM accounts
Just-in-time privileged access; no standing RMM global administrators
Second approver for multi-customer RMM actions; AI agent scoped
Lockout and session limits, including bench screen lock
Vendor remote access through PAM
Customer MFA offered; required for business account administrators; verified device release
Report suspected incidents, including device misuse, within 1 hour
One severity scale; group playbooks; P08 runbook
Record suspicion, determination, and discovery dates for each division
Contract notice clocks listed with owners (merchants, manufacturers, TPA, enterprise, BAAs)
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 12.10.1); Manufacturer A agreement (contract); TPA agreement (contract)

statement_summary: Counsel-owned notification matrix; third-party agent notices
Disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of a materiality determination
Ransom decisions with OFAC sanctions check
Annual cross-division exercise with both merchants and IT Support
Evidence and customer devices held under chain of custody
Classes; customer devices treated as Restricted
Encryption of Restricted data
Passcodes in the vault only, purged after release; no account passwords collected
Card data only in P2PE terminals or hosted payment fields
Retention: vault 7 days, recovered data 30 days, caches at session end, transcripts 90 days
Customer data access standard: no browsing or copying; session logging; USB blocked; signed by technicians
Sanitization on SP 800-88 Rev. 2 with verification and per-device certificates
Background check reports kept only in the HR system
Immutable backups restore-tested quarterly
No Restricted data to unapproved AI services; no ticket notes to AI
Acknowledgment at hire and every year; signed access standard
Annual training; phishing exercises; role courses for technicians, RMM administrators, and store teams
Managed devices only; no personal phones for customer content
Approved generative AI tools only
Remote sessions only with customer consent
